page.overview:
Who is Farmworld Finn's Wife?

Farmworld Finn's wife is a posthumous character who was mentioned in "Destiny". Presumably, shortly after Finn returned to normal, he met Huntress and had five children with her. Some years later, she passed away the same day she cooked a soup, to which her family continues to add ingredients to prevent it from running out. The latter seems to be a way to remember her fondly.

Her identity as the Farmworld version of Huntress Wizard was later indirectly confirmed in "The Bear and the Rose" as one of their sons recognized Huntress Wizard and mistook her for his deceased mother.
